homepage.municipality_eyebrow: Munisipalidad ya Ikatlong Klase · Region I
homepage.municipality_title: Sakey a baley ya man-aani na palay ed terser a distrito na Pangasinan
homepage.municipality_desc: Nakatugaw so Mapandan ed Ikatlong Kongresonal a Distrito na Pangasinan, napaliber ed San Jacinto ed norte, Mangaldan ed hilagang-kanluran, Manaoag ed east, tan Santa Barbara ed south. Say lawak to et 32.92 square kilometers, tan antapud 3/4 na daga et para ed agrikultura—pangunahing palay, kaiba so mais, alaga a animales, tan pana-panahon a gulay. Mantrabaho so administrasyon na baley ed silong na tagline a “Kaakibat niyo ang Aktibo at Responsableng Liderato.”
homepage.milestone1_desc: Say lugar et kaabay na Mangaldan bilang saray southern barrio—Payapay, Baloling, Apaya, tan Amanoaoac—ya pinangaranan gapu ed dakel a mabangong pandan ed floodplain na Agno River.
homepage.milestone2_desc: Itinayneng bilang independent a munisipalidad diad Director General No. 39, panguloan na sampolokal a lider kaiba da Antonio Morales, Sabino Prado, tan Andres Bongato.
homepage.milestone3_desc: Sakey a matinding epidemya so nanggawa ed Mapandan a temporaryong ma-re-annex ed Mangaldan lapud financial insolvency. Naibalik so full autonomy ed 1909 diad Executive Order No. 10 ni Governor General James F. Smith.
homepage.milestone4_desc: Sakey a munisipalidad ya 15 barangay tan 38,228 residente, ya mamuhunan ed Super Health Center, Pandan Festival, tan paglago na imprastraktura.

legislative.legal_basis_desc: Man-ooperate so Municipality of Mapandan ed silong na Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991), ed Ikatlong Kongresonal a Distrito na Pangasinan. Say Sangguniang Bayan—sakey a unicameral local legislative council—so mangipatupad na municipal legislative power. Pangulo to so Municipal Vice Mayor tan kaiba iray elected councilors tan ex-officio representatives na Liga ng mga Barangay tan Sangguniang Kabataan Federation.
